51129326.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His6 tagged VHL (54 to 213 residues)/ELoC (17 to 112 residues)/EloB (1 to 120 residues) (unknown origin) complex expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. The protein sample (VHL:Elc:Elb complex) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.01% Tween 20. The ligand (MB756) was dissolved in the same buffer. The protein sample (100 μL, 100 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and the ligand (200 μL, 1.5 mM) was loaded into the syringe. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. The dissociation constants (Kd) were calculated from the binding isotherms. The experiments were performed in triplicate, and the data are presented as mean ± SD.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% Tween 20
